name: AOS 4-Tier Progressive Quality Gate & SDK Lifecycle Hooks
description: Multi-tier deterministic execution gates with stack-adaptive detection (Node/TS, Python, Rust, Go) and SDK Stop-Hook auto-healing continuation semantics.

pre_tool_call_decide.description: Lightweight boundary sanity check executed before tool actions (workspace isolation and path boundaries).

post_task.description: Quality gate executed on subagent finish. When checks fail, the SDK stop hook returns StopDecision.CONTINUE with error output to trigger autonomous self-healing.

checks.name: stack_adaptive_typecheck
checks.command: node .agents/scripts/run-hook.cjs npx tsc --noEmit || mypy . || cargo check

checks.name: stack_adaptive_unit_tests
checks.command: node .agents/scripts/run-hook.cjs npx vitest run || pytest || cargo test

pre_merge.description: Exhaustive integration, security, and build gate executed before merging branch worktrees into main.

checks.name: security_ast_scan
checks.command: node .agents/scripts/run-hook.cjs npx semgrep scan --config auto --error || bandit -r .

checks.name: integration_tests
checks.command: node .agents/scripts/run-hook.cjs npx vitest run --testPathPattern=integration || pytest tests/integration

checks.name: production_compilation
checks.command: node .agents/scripts/run-hook.cjs npm run build || cargo build --release

pre_production.description: Zero-downtime release gate validating database migrations, smoke tests, and rollback safety.

checks.name: smoke_test_suite
checks.command: node .agents/scripts/run-hook.cjs npm run test:smoke || pytest tests/smoke
